objective: Continue the fastest prediction-research path without waiting for odds or other non-essential fields.
execution_priority: Run or reproduce the frozen PRE-only prediction path on historical/prospective racecards using the minimum model-required fields first.
Generate candidate tickets independently of live odds.
For every candidate ticket calculate and persist the minimum acceptable odds threshold implied by the frozen decision/economic policy.
Run controlled input ablation to determine which optional PRE-only fields materially improve predictive accuracy.
Remove non-material fields from the simulation blocker set.
Collect genuine pre-close odds opportunistically for execution-price and formal ROI validation, but never pause prediction research waiting for them.
non_blockers: live odds when not mathematically required by the frozen prediction model
optional PRE metadata not proven to improve prediction materially
hard_blockers: unresolved participant identity required by the frozen model
missing field explicitly required by the exact frozen model
reason_no_increment: This queue and policy persistence improve execution/research throughput but do not add genuine prospective scientific evidence by themselves.
